description: The identity table of [DB §2.19]: the 37 rows that DB's run_identity.py computed (34 pairs and three policy variants of case 3a), as the tests of identity.relate (DESIGN §2.9, §10.5).
ruling: DESIGN §2.9: under the §2.6 ruling (the bound table: undated facts have no definite validity, so they never collide on a temporal key), X3 and C4a-u are key_timeline; DB recorded key_conflict.

fields.relations: relation declarations of khg-relation-schema/1.0.0, by the name DB gave each variant
fields.relation: the declaration that decides the case; a test schema holds it alone
fields.on_collision: a policy that overrides the declaration's (the three variants of case 3a)
fields.existing: the bindings of the stored fact b (asserted)
fields.incoming: the bindings of the incoming fact a (asserted)
fields.label: identity.relate(a, b, schema=...)
fields.action: the §2.5 action of the one conflict record.keys.collisions reports when a is written beside b; null when a write collides with nothing
fields.schema_error: the M code load_schema reports for the case's schema (the relation is then used unchecked)
